people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
translations.bsb: Moses entered the cloud as he went up on the mountain, and he remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights.
translations.kjv: And Moses went into the midst of the cloud, and gat him up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
translations.asv: And Moses entered into the midst of the cloud, and went up into the mount: and Moses was in the mount forty days and forty nights.
